Hi Thiago, it's Rachel. A quick update before the weekend. The client called this morning, and they are moving the progress meeting from Tuesday to Thursday, so we are presenting the schedule on Thursday at ten. I need your slides by Wednesday at noon, please. Also, the crew is not working on Friday, because of the holiday, so the excavation is starting a day later. That is fine, we are still on track for the first milestone. I am flying to Brazil on the twentieth, and I am visiting the site with you on the twenty-second. Talk soon.

Good morning, everyone, this is Dave, the site manager. Here is the plan for next week. On Monday we are closing the north road, so please use the east gate. The concrete trucks are arriving on Tuesday and Wednesday, early in the morning. On Thursday the inspector from the utility is visiting, and all the safety reports must be ready by Wednesday night. If you need a day off next month, tell me by Friday. That is all. Have a safe week.

First, the client approves the design, and phase one is finished. Then, the team kicks off phase two, and the crew arrives on site. After that, the foundations of Station 1 are finished by April 11. Next, the pumps for Station 2 are installed on May 19, two weeks later than planned. Finally, the handover happens on August 29.
